Seen • Just now
You can view and manage most of your details by logging into My Account on our website. That’s where you can access your account information and saved addresses. 
A couple of things to keep in mind:
The email address on an existing account can’t be changed. If you need a different email, you’ll need to create a new account.
If you want to change the name on your account, you can request to speak with a person and share your current name, the new name, and the shipping address on the account.
So for most details, just log into your account and update them there 😊
